description: Add a user to an org or change their role. Roles: 'developer', 'admin', 'owner'. If the user is already in the org, updates the role. Omitting `role` keeps the member's current role: this tool reads the roster first and re-sends the existing role explicitly, because the registry DEFAULTS an omitted role to 'developer' rather than preserving it (which would silently demote an admin or owner). For a user who is not yet a member, omitting `role` adds them as 'developer'.

confirm.description: Must be literally true. Guards against accidental org membership changes.

name: npm_org_member_set
